message:
The `SplashFont` base class initializes `mat` and `textMat` arrays. But `SplashFTFont` has its own `matrix` and `textMatrix` members (of type `FT_Matrix`), which are separate from the base class's `mat` and `textMat`. Let me check the header:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/poppler && grep -n "matrix\|textMatrix" splash/SplashFTFont.h</｜｜DSML｜｜>
